description: Player 0 has 1 checker at point 3 (all in home, 14 borne off). Dice [5,3]. Die-3 is exact; die-5 is larger. Only 1 move possible with each die; larger-die rule forces die-5. Result: 3/off using die 5.
notes: Both die-5 and die-3 can bear off the checker at 3 (die-5 via larger-die rule, die-3 exact). Max 1 move. Larger die (5) must be used. Both reach same final state, deduplicated to 1.
